description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for corner cases in identification strings used in git commits. It verifies behavior when author/committer names and emails are empty, contain special characters, or are unset. The script ensures that git handles these cases correctly and produces expected error messages.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables in a way that ensures no residual value remains

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, typically used to verify error conditions

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern appears in the output or error messages

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings for differences

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script
